This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 16-05-2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Atlântico
Distribuição SA, with its registered office at Rua Augusta 100, Lisboa ("Party A"), and Atlântico Distribuição SA, with its registered office
at Rua Augusta 100, Lisboa ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 36 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in accordance with
Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this
Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by Swedish law.
